commands.command: /bin/zsh -lc 'nl -ba tests/test_tasks.py; cat docs/export-notes.md; python3 --version; PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -v'

/bin/zsh -lc "git diff --check; git diff --stat; git status --short; git diff -- tasklist tests docs/export-notes.md; python3 -B - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
import re
paths = [Path('README.md'), Path('AGENTS.md'), Path('CLAUDE.md'), Path('docs/task-completion.md')]
for path in paths:
    text = path.read_text()
    for target in re.findall(r'\\]\\((["'^)]+)'"\\)', text):
        assert (path.parent / target).is_file(), (path, target)
assert Path('AGENTS.md').is_file()
assert '@AGENTS.md' in Path('CLAUDE.md').read_text()
print('Documentation links and Claude guidance import resolve.')
PY"
